name: Acceptance
blurb: Build public and political acceptance of AI as a positive, trustworthy tool.

name: Education About AI
blurb: Explain plainly what AI is, how it works, and why it matters.

name: Smart Regulation & Guardrails
blurb: Call for balanced rules that protect people without stifling innovation.

name: Workforce Transition & Jobs
blurb: Support reskilling and protect workers as AI changes the job market.

name: Public Funding & Investment
blurb: Advocate for research funding and investment in AI infrastructure.

name: Ethical & Responsible Use
blurb: Promote fairness, non-discrimination, and human oversight of AI.

name: Data Privacy Protections
blurb: Protect personal data and give people control over how AI uses it.

name: Equitable Access & Digital Divide
blurb: Ensure everyone benefits from AI, not just the well-connected.

name: Innovation & Economic Competitiveness
blurb: Keep the state and country at the forefront of AI innovation.

name: Transparency & Accountability
blurb: Demand that AI systems be explainable and accountable.

name: Safety & Risk Mitigation
blurb: Address real risks so AI is deployed safely and responsibly.

name: Public-Private Partnership
blurb: Bring government, industry, and communities together on AI.
